notes: Baseten's PRIMARY product is dedicated deployments billed per GPU-minute regardless of tokens (H100 80GB $6.50/hr, B200 $9.98/hr, A100 $4.00/hr). None of that is per-token and none of it belongs in this table.
The endpoint here is the separate 'Model APIs' product, which is billed per million tokens. Only that is captured.
The docs claim GET /models returns pricing and context windows, but an unauthenticated probe returned only an auth error, so the response shape is unverified.
Further priced models appear on the pricing page but their exact API id strings were not confirmed, so they are omitted rather than guessed.
context_window and max_output are unconfirmed for every model and are omitted.
